title: Open link in same tab, pop-up as tab: settings
description: The settings in chrome.storage.sync. defaults.json holds every one at its default; storage holds only what the user changed, merged over it key by key.

t1pop.description: Move a new pop-up window's tab into the main window as a tab. Other extensions' pop-ups stay as windows. Read at start-up, so changing it reloads the extension.

t1foc.description: Give a tab moved from a pop-up window focus. Read at start-up, so changing it reloads the extension.

t1tab.description: Open target="_blank" links in the current tab instead of a new one. Takes effect on pages loaded after the change.
